config firewall policy
    edit 230679
        set status disable
        set name "netops-firewall-services-679"
        set uuid 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002
        set srcintf "host01"
        set dstintf "host01"
        set action accept
        set srcaddr "all"
        set dstaddr "netops-firewall-services-679-vip"
        set schedule "always"
        set service "ALL_TCP"
        set utm-status enable
        set ssl-ssh-profile "certificate-inspection"
        set av-profile "default"
        set webfilter-profile "default"
        set dnsfilter-profile "default"
        set ips-sensor "default"
        set application-list "default"
        set logtraffic all
        set nat enable
        set ippool enable
        set poolname "netops-firewall-services-679-pool"
    next
end
